subject: [PATCH 17/60] PM: hibernate: size the image from common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted an initial patch and explanation of the problem, but no further discussion or review comments have been made yet.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the hibernation mechanism in Linux by correctly sizing the image from common memory. The current implementation counts free pages of every populated zone as room for the hibernation image, but the pages used to store the image can only come from common memory. This patch specifically addresses this issue by counting free pages only in zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes.
